title: 第3章 十倍奖励千年灵芝第4章 洗髓伐骨实力爆涨
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
嗯？？？
听到休书二字后，那首座上的老者也是目光一冷，微眯的双眸缓慢睁开。
气氛顿时变得压抑无比。
……
与此同时。
云惜雪再次压制不住心中愤怒。
寒声呵道：“敢如此羞辱我，找死！”
话音落下。
云惜雪杀意手臂快速凝结出冰晶，周身气息快速暴动，直接朝江宇就冲了过去。
另一边。
黑袍男原本想动手的，见云惜雪动用寒冰之力后，他当即选择在原地观望。
以云惜雪锻体境六重实力，再加上自身寒冰体，就算一般的锻体九重都不是她的对手，更别说一个小小的江宇了。
江文康：“宇儿小心！”
看着这云惜雪竟直接发动攻击，江文康也快速调动自身真气，抬手就抓了过去。
对方这一出手。
江文康当即察觉到了不对劲，江宇就锻体一重修为，若是被云惜雪正面击中。
那绝对是有死无生。
此时。
江文康双目变得血红。

神海境三重的实力全面爆发。
轰隆——
然而。
江文康身形刚冲出去一半，首座上长老目光微眯，一道恐怖的威压瞬间弥漫而出。
随着这股威压一出现。
江文康及江家众人身形一顿，仿佛有一座大山压在身上一般。
身体被禁锢在了原地。
“啊～”
关键时刻。
江文康强咬着牙，竟硬生生突破老者的气息封锁，快速挡在了江宇身前。
“轰隆！”
可他还是慢了几分，虽抵挡住了大部分攻击，但还是有不少余波落在江宇身上。
“噗！”
“轰隆！”
江宇口中喷出一口鲜血，身体直接倒飞了出去，砸在一旁的门框上。
除此以外。
周身更是快速被冰晶覆盖。
江文康：“宇儿！”
看到这一幕。
江文康睚眦欲裂，可老者的气势再次暴涨了几分，他此时根本无法移动分毫。

“云惜雪，你好狠的心。”
江文康转头看向了云惜雪，口中传出一阵低沉的怒吼声。
“哼，这是他自己找死而已。”
面对江文康的怒吼，云惜雪则是一脸的不屑，丝毫没把他放在眼里
content_en:
………………
Um? ? ?
After hearing the word divorce, the old man in the front seat also turned cold and slowly opened his slightly narrowed eyes.
The atmosphere suddenly became extremely depressing.
……
at the same time.
Yun Xixue once again couldn't suppress the anger in her heart.
He shouted in a cold voice: "If you dare to humiliate me like this, you are seeking death!"
The words fell.
Yun Xixue's murderous arm quickly condensed ice crystals, and the aura around her body quickly rioted, and she rushed towards Jiang Yu.
other side.
The man in black robe originally wanted to take action, but after seeing Yun Xixue using the power of ice, he immediately chose to wait and see.
With Yun Xixue's strength at the sixth level of the body forging realm, coupled with her own ice body, even the ordinary ninth level of body forging is no match for her, let alone a little Jiang Yu.
Jiang Wenkang: "Yu'er, be careful!"
Seeing that Yun Xixue launched a direct attack, Jiang Wenkang quickly mobilized his own energy and raised his hand to grab it.
The other party took action.
Jiang Wenkang immediately noticed something was wrong, so Jiang Yu trained his body to the first level to avoid being hit by Yun Xixue head-on.
That is definitely life and death.
at this time.
Jiang Wenkang's eyes turned blood red.
The strength of the third level of the Divine Sea Realm exploded in full force.
Boom——
However.
Just as Jiang Wenkang was halfway out, the elder on the front seat narrowed his eyes slightly, and a terrifying pressure instantly filled the air.
As soon as this pressure appeared.
Jiang Wenkang and everyone in the Jiang family froze, as if a huge mountain was pressing on them.
The body was imprisoned in place.
"Ah~"
Crucial moment.
Jiang Wenkang gritted his teeth and broke through the old man's aura blockade, quickly blocking Jiang Yu.
"Boom!"
But he was still a little slower. Although he withstood most of the attacks, there were still many aftermaths that fell on Jiang Yu.
"Poof!"
"Boom!"
Jiang Yu spurted a mouthful of blood, and his body flew backwards, hitting the door frame nearby.
Other than that.
The whole body was quickly covered by ice crystals.
Jiang Wenkang: "Yu'er!"
See this scene.
Jiang Wenkang's eyes were about to burst, but the old man's momentum surged again, and he was unable to move at all at this time.
"Yun Xixue, you are so cruel."
Jiang Wenkang turned to look at Yun Xixue, and a deep roar came from his mouth.
"Humph, he is just looking for death."
Facing Jiang Wenkang's roar, Yun Xixue looked disdainful and did not take him seriously at all.
